generation.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: original raster tool-recognition illustration for an agriculture learning app.
Primary request: a single metal DOUBLE OPEN-ENDED SPANNER (Japanese 両口スパナ). BOTH ends have clearly open U-shaped jaws, the two jaw openings visibly different sizes. A slender solid steel handle joins the two heads. This is specifically an open/open spanner, never an open/ring combination wrench.
Style: clean colored 2D educational product illustration, precise recognizable silhouette, restrained steel-gray shading with subtle blue highlights, softly outlined edges.
Scene/backdrop: plain warm off-white square background, gentle small grounding shadow.
Composition: show the whole tool at a slight diagonal across the square, close to a top-down view so the two open jaw cutouts are completely clear; generous empty margins on every side, no cropped ends.
Constraints: one tool only. No text, no Japanese characters, no letters, no numbers or measurement markings, no logo, no watermark, no hands, no nuts or bolts, no action scene. Both jaws are open, no closed circular ring at either end, no adjustable worm screw.
